$comment: MCP tools exposed by the Arffornia playtest probe (a dev/test-only NeoForge client+server mod). Transport: streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:25599, bearer token from config/arffornia-playtest.toml. Never shipped in the player pack. Shapes follow MCP tool definitions (name, description, inputSchema).

tools.name: observe
tools.description: One call per step: a screenshot (PNG, downscaled to max_width) plus the structured state the agent should trust over pixels: player (pos, rot, health, hunger, gamemode, selected slot), open screen (class, title, widgets with id/label/bounds/enabled/focused: the accessibility tree), crosshair target (block id + pos + face, or entity), chat since last call, log lines at WARN+ since last call, game tick.

radius.description: include block entities from our mods within this radius

tools.name: block
tools.description: Block state, block entity NBT (filtered to public fields) and, for Arffornia machines, the machine state (recipe, progress 0..1, energy, input/output slots, formed/not formed).

tools.name: click_widget
tools.description: Activate a widget of the open screen by id from observe (semantic click: robust to GUI scale and resolution).

tools.name: slot
tools.description: Click a container slot (inventory, machine GUI) by index, like a player: pickup, place, quick-move (shift), split (right).

tools.name: input
tools.description: Raw input as a fallback: press/hold/release a key mapping (by name: key.forward, key.use, key.inventory...) or move/click the mouse in screen coordinates. Holding is bounded by ticks.

text.description: type text into the focused field

tools.name: look
tools.description: Turn the camera to face a block position or an entity id (no mouse-look guessing).

tools.name: goto
tools.description: Walk to a position with Baritone if installed (proves reachability), else teleport (test worlds only). Returns when arrived, stuck, or after max_ticks.

tools.name: use
tools.description: Use the held item / interact with the block or entity under the crosshair (right click), or attack/break (left). Optionally select a hotbar slot first.

tools.name: command
tools.description: Run a server command as an operator. Test worlds only: the probe refuses when the server is not a test/preview server. Use for setup (give, setblock, fill, place structure), never to fake the behaviour under test.

tools.name: time
tools.description: Deterministic time control with the vanilla /tick command: freeze, step N ticks, or run until a predicate holds (evaluated server-side each tick) or max_ticks.

until.description: predicate DSL, e.g. machine(10,64,3).progress >= 1 or inventory.count('arffornia:iron_plate') >= 4

tools.name: scenario
tools.description: Test-world control: reset to a named template (a GameTest structure + seed + gamerules: no daylight cycle, no weather, no mob spawning), mark a log position, start/stop recording (frames saved for the report video).

tools.name: assert
tools.description: Record a check in the run report (does not stop the run). Kinds: block, machine, inventory, chat, no_errors_since(mark), screenshot_matches(baseline, tolerance). Returns pass/fail + evidence.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Which of the PR's changed methods ran since the scenario started (JaCoCo agent on the client and server JVMs, filtered to the diff). Tells the agent what it has NOT exercised yet.
